source: Inspired by assets/Corp Deck 2025 - Nov.pptx slide 13 (Three Challenges) and assets/template/Business Process Agentification (Session 4).pptx slide 8 (Components). Corp S13 uses a PowerPoint TABLE that does not decompose into our shape model, so this is a structural seed, not a pixel reproduction.
intent: Read-fast 3-pillar framing for a claim-led headline ('three forces / pillars / challenges'). Use when the audience needs to absorb three parallel concepts as equal-weight, where ordering does not imply sequence and metrics are not the point.
invariants: exactly 3 cards in a row, equal width via the 12-col grid (4/4/4)
each card has a top accent bar (xs height) in a distinct theme color
card title uses hero type style (large, bold) and text_primary color
card body is 2-3 sentences in body type style; no bullets
header bar with kicker + claim-headline sits above the cards
no images, no metrics, no icons in this variant — pure typographic
variables: card body length (35-65 words each, prose not bullets)
accent rotation order across the three cards
header kicker label (matches the framing word, e.g. 'Three forces')
headline (claim with a verb, must include 'three' or its synonym)
